outcome: Inflammatory laboratory parameters (lymphocyte, neutrophil, eosinophil, aspartate aminotransferase, alanine aminotransferase, lactate dehydrogenase, neutrophil lymphocyte ratio, platelet lymphocyte ratio, eosinophil lymphocyte ratio, monocyte eosinophil ratio)
cohort: The study included 369 peripartum women admitted for delivery, comprising 95 with asymptomatic COVID-19 and 274 age and gestational age-matched controls.
finding: Asymptomatic COVID-19 in peripartum women was associated with increased monocyte-to-eosinophile ratio and LDH levels, decreased lymphocyte count, and an increase in late preterm delivery, but not with increased maternal and neonatal mortality or major morbidity.
